notes: Received with thanks in full and final settlement of INV-281/2026 dated 13-10-2026. The account stands settled; there is no balance outstanding.

WARRANTY. Six (6) months from the date of INV-281/2026 on the expansion valve supplied and on our workmanship, as stated on that invoice. Excludes failure caused by moisture or contamination carried from elsewhere in the system, a leak outside the work carried out, power surge, improper supply, or absence of routine maintenance.

FILTER DRIER. As noted on our invoice, the filter drier should be renewed whenever a sealed refrigeration circuit has been opened. If the drier on this system has not been changed we recommend it be done at the earliest opportunity, a saturated drier being the most common cause of a repeat expansion valve failure. We will be pleased to attend and quote.
We thank you for your continued custom and remain at your service for routine maintenance of your refrigeration plant.
